result.summary: The home screen is mostly intact, but one restaurant title in the 'Popular right now' list is visibly clipped mid-character. The partially visible carousel item and the bottom-cut pizza card are expected scrolling behaviour and are not reported.

issues.description: The restaurant name on the first 'Popular right now' card reads 'Tokumaru Rameı': the final letter is sliced off mid-glyph with no ellipsis. There is plenty of empty space between the title and the rating on the right, so the title container appears to be too narrow or has overflow hidden.
issues.suggestion: Remove the fixed or constrained width on the title so it can fill the space up to the rating block (e.g. flex: 1). If truncation is ever needed, use a proper ellipsis rather than a hard clip.
